descriptions.d11c_cursor_dots_8002d8bc: Set up the airstrike cursor through 0x8004e0dc with its mesh, bitmap, null, intro, loop and error literals, then five times name a handle "Airstrike.Cursor.Dot", cast it through 0x8034357c, retain it into dots[i] at +92 (releasing the old one) and attach it to the +28 object's slot +92 with the i-th "Dot_Null_0N" name from 0x803f3c68.
